messages:
Ivy (platform): FYI we found a 40m hole in telemetry that bumped agg-hours for eu-west. proposing a narrow reprocess for shards [210..213]. want a preflight that returns: est_cost, slot-heatmap diff (before/after), and SLO-risk probability. prefer simulate-only preflight.
Diego (ops): +1 to simulate-only. need per-shard cost and a tiny canary plan (1 shard). ops worried about slot contention during EU business hours.
Sam (eng-runtime): Canary + kv-warmup makes sense. runtime notes: when we simulate, include cache-warmup delta and model cold-start time in SLO risk calc. I'll add a kv_warmup param and default canary to 1 shard @1.5x cpu.
Rae (console): UI idea: show a compact heatmap diff (current vs post-shim) and a single-line risk summary (e.g. "SLO hit prob 2.3% — low"). question: should preflight actually mutate a temp quota shim resource for a realistic plan, or keep it purely simulated?
Ivy (platform): simulate-only for preflight. operator explicitly applies a shim with redwoodctl if they accept. this keeps preflight idempotent and auditable.
Diego (ops): runbook snippet for apply if preflight looks good:
```
# apply temporary shard quota bump
redwoodctl tenants label acme-euw --add backfill:5189990001
redwoodctl quota adjust --tenant acme-euw --shard 210 --delta-tokens +3 --duration 2h
redwoodctl backfill start --shards 210 --cohort canary --kv-warmup=true --tag euhole-5189990001
```
Sam (eng-runtime): for simulation accuracy I'll include parameters: ttl=15m, warmup=true, additional_cold_start_ms=400. simulator will emit both est_cost_usd and slo_hit_probability_pct.
Rae (console): API debate: either call /planner/simulate (fast) or add a consolidated /api/v1/backfill/preflight that calls planner internally and returns UI-friendly fields. I prefer new consolidated endpoint to avoid plumbing planner internals into the UI.
Ivy (platform): agree on a consolidated read-only endpoint. API contract should return: preflight_id, shards_considered (aliases only), est_cost_usd, slot_heatmap_diff (stringified summary), slo_risk_level (low/med/high), slo_hit_probability_pct, recommended_actions[]. also emit telemetry: preflight.requester, preflight.estimated_cost_usd.
Diego (ops): security: redact tenant GUIDs, limit shards_considered length, and require operator token. Finance wants preflight.cost_tag so they can attribute spend to "ops:ad-hoc-replay".
preflight-bot: preflight queued: preflight-5189990001 (simulate shards=[210]) status=queued
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll implement the warmup flag and simulator hooks. will also add an integration test that validates the slo_hit_probability metric is emitted.
Rae (console): I'll wire a modal to POST /api/v1/backfill/preflight and render the heatmap diff and a short action card with the runbook snippet. will post mockups in #console-proto by EOD.
Ivy (platform): action items: Sam implement simulator changes + tests; Rae build UI mock + call shape; Diego update runbook and own the operator play; Ivy will file platform#812 (preflight API spec) and attach contract. target micro-canary tonight 22:30 UTC if ready.
Diego (ops): +1 on timeline. I'll be oncall and ready to rollback affinity/quotas.
Sam (eng-runtime): +1. I'll ensure kv-warmup default true for canary and add a short TTL for cache to avoid long-lived churn.
Rae (console): +1. will include cost attribution field in the UI.
Ivy (platform): thanks all  closing thread. will link the ticket once platform#812 exists.
